THE PATRIARCH

The Patriarch and Matriarch: The Patriarch and Matriarch: Sri. Venkiteswara Iyer & Rajammal At the heart of our family’s history are Sri. Venkiteswara Iyer and his wife, Rajammal, who built their lives around our ancestral home of Ezhakaram in Vallioor. Sri. Venkiteswara Iyer was a man of remarkable intellect and charisma. Fluent in English, Sanskrit, and Malayalam, he served as a "Dvibhashi" (translator) at the Maharaja’s palace in Trivandrum. A natural wanderer, he acted as a sort of roving ambassador, frequently traveling to various temples and festivals. He was also the only man in the family of his era to undertake the grueling pilgrimage to Kasi. In a time when such a journey meant a perilous two-to-three-year trek on foot from which many never returned, he completed it in style andsafely returned to Vallioor. Always thoughtful, he left a quiet final legacy: at the time of his passing, he had tucked loose change under his pillow, seemingly to ensure no one else would have to bear the expenses for his funeral.
While he traveled, the brilliant and deeply admired Rajammal held the family together. With the support of her father-in-law, Andi Iyer, she not only raised eight children but also served the surrounding villages of Vallioor as a respected midwife and nadi doctor. She is remembered as a woman of striking beauty (often compared to Kannan's mother in family lore) and immense resilience.
The Second Generation Together, Sri. Venkiteswara Iyer and Rajammal had four sons and four daughters. Though none of this generation are alive today, their lives form the foundational branches of ourfamily tree:
The Sons
• Venkataraman (Eldest): Tragically passed away around the age of 22 before his marriage could be consummated. His young widow is believed to have taken Sanyasam before passing away years later.
• Viswanatha Iyer: A ration merchant based in Perumbavoor. He passed away in 1953 at the age of 58 due to a kidney condition.
• Sivarama Krishna Iyer: A hotelier in Elayangudi, who passed away around 1959. He is the father of Mookandi (of Delhi).
• Gopalakrishna Iyer: A hotelier in Paramakkudy or Elayangudi. He is the father of Venkittu, Sankaran, and others.
The Daughters
• Annam Ammal (Eldest): Mother of Vallikutty and Lakshmi (of Cochin). Lakshmi married Sattanatha Iyer (originally from Perumazhanchi, later settled in Cochin).
• Ponnammal: Mother of Bombay Ramanathan.
• Bhagavathy: Mother of Chuppayya.
• Valli (Youngest): Mother of Calcutta Lakshmanan, and grandmother to Naresh.
